expectedClaims.label: Shots against opposing defense
expectedClaims.text: Example Away recorded 12 shots on goal per game across 5 games in the 2025–2026 regular sample (2026-09-01T00:00:00.000Z to 2026-10-13T00:00:00.000Z); Example Home allowed 12 shots on goal per game across 5 games in that same window. The recorded same-period comparison is 10 shots on goal per game. Both rates are at least ten percent above that comparison. If these patterns continue, Example Away could record more shots on goal than that benchmark against Example Home.
